About these prices & updates

Prices are ungraded Holofoil TCGplayer market estimates supplied by TCGTracking Open API ↗. The provider caches prices for one day. This page checks for newer data every 15 minutes while open; it does not receive instant sale-by-sale prices. Provider update times are shown in Singapore time.

SGD is converted from USD using the latest available daily Frankfurter exchange rate ↗, not a Singapore market quote. Actual sale values vary with condition, fees, and demand. Values count one copy of each checked card.

Unpriced cards are excluded from totals, not valued at zero. The eight Energy entries currently have no verified matching listing in these feeds. A subtotal is labelled partial whenever any relevant cards are unpriced. If a feed fails, the last successful data is kept with its original update date.
